objective: Third review iteration of d2: fix TR-D-15 / SEC-D-16 (a call ended by close() was settled at 0 while a timeout is charged at the cap) and SEC-D-17 (cli.test.js sandbox PATH may reach a real claude; empty temp cwds left by the exit hook), inside d2 ownership only.
context: Review rev-mv35hyoj-01e0a18c, drafts phase-d-2.json TR-D-15 and phase-d-security-2.md SEC-D-16/17. The gate (src/ai/gate.js, d1) refunds a rejected call at microUsdOfUsage(err.usage) and at 0 when err.usage is absent; the service watchdog (src/services/extraction.js callProvider, d3) rejects PROVIDER_TIMEOUT with usage { costMicroUsd: cap }. The shared provider contract test (test/unit/ai/provider-contract.test.js) requires any attached err.usage to have the FULL usage shape (model, costUsd, integer costMicroUsd, token counts, latencyMs), so the adapter marker is the full shape with costMicroUsd = the per-call cap rather than the bare watchdog object; the gate reads only costMicroUsd, so the charge is identical. No real model, no claude binary and no network were used; every command ran with PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin and RS_LIVE_MODEL was never set. The CLI adapter tests use only the repository stub (stub-claude.mjs) in a temp bin directory.
expectedOutput: An adapter whose killed-started-child rejections (close(), SIGKILL after grace, timeout, abort, output flood) carry the per-call cap as usage so the gate charges the cap; an exit hook that also removes the temp cwd; a cli.test.js sandbox that can never reach a real claude.
acceptanceCriteria: After close() with a call in flight the rejected call carries usage with costMicroUsd equal to the per-call cap, like a timeout
An unchanged call still settles at its reported usage; a failed call that reported usage keeps it
Through a real gate the ledger row of a close()-ended call is settled at the cap, not 0
The cli.test.js child PATH is the stub directory alone and every provider uses the stub's absolute path as command
The exit hook leaves no empty rs-cli-* temp cwd
The d2 plan verification command passes and npm test is green
completedWork: FINDING TR-D-15 / SEC-D-16 -> CHANGE src/ai/cli.js: call() builds unknownAtCap() = usageOf(null, ...) with costMicroUsd = callCapMicroUsd and costUsd = cap/1e6 (full usage shape) and passes it to runOnce. terminate() (close()) and the child 'close' handler of a terminated run now reject PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE with { usage: unknownAtCap() }. fail() (timeout, abort during a run, 8 MiB flood) attaches the same marker whenever a child had been started; a call that never started a process (closed before spawn, spawn error, missing binary, early abort) stays without usage because nothing can have been billed. -> TEST test/unit/ai/cli.test.js: 'TR-D-15: a call in flight when close() runs rejects PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE carrying the per-call cap as its usage' (cap 70000), 'a child that ignores SIGTERM and is SIGKILLed ... charged at the cap', 'the ledger charges the cap for a call ended by close(); an unchanged call still settles at its reported usage' (real gate and SQLite: normal call settles at 1300, billed failure keeps 1300, hang+close row goes reserved 50000/null -> settled 50000/50000), 'a call that never started a process is not charged', and the existing timeout test now asserts the marker. -> EVIDENCE red first ev:ev-mv35r9e5-01f5fecd (cli.test.js: 38 tests, 34 pass, 4 fail), green ev:ev-mv35sbuc-019020e2 (38/38). FINDING SEC-D-17 -> CHANGE cli.test.js sandbox env PATH is the stub bin directory alone (no process.env.PATH, no node dir; the wrapper shebang and node are absolute), every sandbox provider, cliVersion and the driver get command = absolute stub path; the exit-hook driver env PATH is the stub dir alone (test/fixtures/extraction/cli-orphan-driver.mjs). cli.js: LIVE_CHILDREN is now a Map child -> cwd and the synchronous exit hook rmSync's the cwd after SIGKILL. -> TEST 'SEC-D-17: the sandbox PATH is the stub directory alone and every provider gets the stub as an absolute command' and the exit-hook test now asserts no rs-cli-* directory remains. -> EVIDENCE same red/green runs. SERVICE (d3) SIDE: what the adapter now reports is err.usage = { model, costUsd: cap/1e6, costMicroUsd: cap, inputTokens: 0, outputTokens: 0, latencyMs } on PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE after close(). The service has nothing more to do: callProvider rethrows the provider error unchanged and gate.run refunds at microUsdOfUsage(err.usage) = cap. The only requirement on d3 is that the extract route does not strip or replace err.usage before gate.run sees it; the in-file test that proves the end-to-end charge is the gate.run test above (src/services untouched). If the reviewer wants the HTTP-level row check it belongs in a d3 API test (hang stub, close the provider, assert model_spend actual = cap), which I did not write because those files are d3's. FINAL RUNS: plan verification command verbatim ev:ev-mv35x27x-01f78f22 (112 tests, 112 pass, 0 fail; fake-mode EXT-1 eval inside it); npm test with --timeout 1800 ev:ev-mv35yihg-01cf262a (1288 tests, 1280 pass, 0 fail, 8 skipped, 0 todo; the same 8 skips as before; ECCODE_EVAL {passed:200,total:200} seen on a direct npm test run of the same tree, provider fake, so it is not evidence of model quality). No red test in d3 files was observed in the final run.
remainingIssues: Scope note: the marker is also attached to the adapter's own timeout, abort-during-run and output-flood kills of a started child (previously refunded at 0 when the adapter's timer fired before the service watchdog). This is the same unknown-billing situation and is conservative; revert-able in fail() if the reviewer disagrees.

SIGKILL of the parent, or SIGTERM/SIGHUP without a handler, still cannot run any hook (FU-28, SIGHUP and double-signal in TR-D-16/SEC-D-15, main.js and the runner, not d2's files): the row stays reserved and the startup sweep settles it at the cap.
The exit hook removes the temp cwd only for children still registered; the three signal deaths without a handler still leave an empty cwd (no code can run).
live-runner-refusal.test.js keeps its own safe PATH ('<stub dir>:/usr/bin:/bin' with an assertion that no claude is there); SEC-D-17 named only cli.test.js, so it was left unchanged.
